WHEREAS the Seller is engaged in the aggregation and sale of agricultural produce from its member farmers; and

WHEREAS the Buyer is engaged in the wholesale supply of food commodities to institutional buyers across the South-West and Federal Capital Territory; and

WHEREAS the parties intend to establish a framework for the supply of graded, clean, and bagged produce on agreed terms;

The contract file for Contract #2021-04 lists parties as Okunrin Cooperative Produce Union and Sunrise Agro Supplies Ltd. Record status: historical.

NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

CLAUSE 1 — COMMODITY
1.1 The Seller shall supply to the Buyer the following commodity: **Dried Brown Beans (Oloyin variety)**.
1.2 The commodity shall be of the current season's harvest, free from admixture of other varieties, stones, or foreign matter.
1.3 The commodity shall have a moisture content not exceeding 12% at the time of delivery.

CLAUSE 2 — QUANTITY AND PRICE
2.1 The total quantity under this Contract shall be **120 (One Hundred and Twenty) Metric Tonnes**.
2.2 The price shall be **₦285,000 (Two Hundred and Eighty-Five Thousand Naira) per Metric Tonne**, subject to adjustment as provided in Amendment No. 1.
2.3 The price is inclusive of bagging (export-grade 50kg polypropylene bags), handling, and loading onto the Buyer's trucks at the Co-op's warehouse in Ijebu-Ode.

CLAUSE 3 — DELIVERY
3.1 Deliveries shall be made in **six (6) monthly lots of 20 Metric Tonnes each**, commencing on 15th May, 2021, and ending on 15th October, 2021.
3.2 The Buyer shall give at least seven (7) days' written notice of truck arrival.
3.3 The Seller shall not be liable for delays caused by force majeure, including but not limited to acts of God, insurrection, or government action.

We refer to our letter of 7th March, 2023 concerning the expiry of Contract #2021-04 for the

the final consignment delivered on 28th February, 2023 was marginally above the 8% specified in
the original Contract, and we would request that this matter be addressed in any future
arrangement.

In light of the above, we hereby propose to enter into negotiations for a new contract for the
supply of shelled groundnuts for the 2023/2024 season, on terms to be agreed. We would suggest

Subject: Status of Contract #2021-04 and Renewal Position

Chief,

   exercised. The Contract is now an archived historical entry in our contract register,
